Introduction
This document outlines the equipment inspection I1, which must be performed every 
 six months as indicated by M6 in the title block.
The first draft initiated and tested by eng. Mahmoud Salah, reviewed by 
 eng Wageh Khalil, 
 accepted by eng Ali Zahran general manager, revised by MDEPCo. Quality control 
 eng. Adel El Naggar, approved by eng Ahmed Sawan head sector of Nubaria 
 Power Station,
This document certified by eng 
 . Samir abd El-Gelil general manager and MPIS coordinator and 
 approved by eng. Mohamed Naguib Abd El-Hay inspection and quality head 
 sector.
Safety 
Precautions
A work permit must be issued
Isolate the power breaker feeding the motor
Tools 
and Equipment
Tester (digital Avometer).
Set off spanners and screw drivers.
250/500 V Megger .
Vacuum cleaner.
Air blower
Work to be 
carried out
During motor isolation
Check motor terminal box.
Check motor fan blades and fan cover.
Measure the winding insulation resistance using Megger
Check motor control cabinet.
General cleaning the surface and air filter by blower
During motor operation
Check motor bearing sound and lubricate the bearing as per 
 motor manual.
Check motor temperature, current, voltage and vibration.
Clean motor air filters
